producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: A footnote in the statement of Theorem 10 says that delta_n implicitly depends on K.
producer_literal_source_notation_points_.material_note: The dependence of delta_n on K belongs to the object; the constant C is asserted independent of n and of the points, but the object itself is K-dependent.

producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: The window is written E_(Kn-K,Kn] and the sums run over lambda_k in (Kn-K,Kn]; the scale comparison uses min(1, K n delta_g(x,y)).
producer_literal_source_notation_points_.material_note: Half-open on the left, closed on the right; the scale factor is K n, with the same K as in the window.

producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: The uniform model writes U_{n,k}; the Gaussian model writes g_{n,k}; both are indexed by the finite set of k with lambda_k in the window.
producer_literal_source_notation_points_.material_note: n labels the window and k labels the eigenfunction inside it; both indices occur in the same display.

producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: The Dudley pseudo-distance is written as a series of squared L^2 norms times delta_n(x,y)^2.
producer_literal_source_notation_points_.material_note: The partial pseudo-distance here is the manifold one of (787-790), not the sphere one of (606-608).

producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: Inside Step 2 of Proposition 17 the integrand is written with min(1, n^2 t^2) under the square root, while Upsilon at (1263) is defined with min(1, n t)^2.
producer_literal_source_notation_points_.material_note: Recorded as the literal printed expression; no rewriting or repair performed here.

producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: The displayed chain opens with a sum over p at least 1 on the line following the same quantity summed over p at least 2.

producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: The first displayed line of the sphere quantitative paragraph repeats the same left-hand expression on both sides before the square root appears.
The text refers to the four conditions of Theorem 2, whereas Theorem 2 lists three enumerated assertions plus a sphere paragraph.
The chi factor is defined with the condition Kn-K < lambda_k <= Kn in one display and with lambda_k in (Kn-K,Kn] elsewhere.
In the torus equivalence display the norm is written with a calligraphic M inside the argument of C^0.
producer_literal_source_notation_points_.material_note: Background display on the torus in the introduction; recorded as printed.

producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: The covering number uses open delta-balls of radius epsilon, and this convention is repeated in the theorem statements.
producer_literal_source_notation_points_.material_note: Open balls, not closed; the entropy integral runs from 0 to infinity.

producer_literal_source_notation_points_.literal: The qualitative proof of Theorem 1 is announced as following from the equivalence of two assertions of Proposition 23, while the proposition lists five.
